newsitem.title: INDIA: India revised 96/97 revenue deficit 2.3 pct/GDP.
newsitem.headline: India revised 96/97 revenue deficit 2.3 pct/GDP.

text.p: India on Friday revised down its estimate of the 1996/97 (April-March) revenue deficit to 2.3 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) from an earlier target of 2.5 percent.

"Taking into account the revised estimates of revenue and expenditure, the revenue deficit has come down from the budget estimate of 2.5 percent of GDP to 2.3 percent of GDP," Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said.
The government revised its estimate of overall gross tax revenue, previously projected at 1,321.5 billion rupees, upwards to 1,323.2 billion rupees.
